name: Government of India Post-Matric Scholarship (SC) - Maharashtra implementation
provider: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra (centrally sponsored, via MahaDBT)

rules.quote: The parents/Guardian annual income shall be less than or equal to Rs. 2,50,000.
Student category shall belong to Scheduled caste or Navbouddha
Student shall belong to resident of Maharashtra
Student should be passes SSC/equivalent Matric.

amount.text: Maintenance allowance per month (max 10 months): day scholar Rs 550/530/300/230, hosteller Rs 1200/820/570/380 by Group I-IV, plus all compulsory fees (tuition, exam, other)
amount.quote: all mandatory fees/ compulsory payable fees i.e. (Tuition Fees, Exam Fees & other Fees) by the student to the institutes are covered under this scheme.

documents.name: Last exam marksheet
documents.quote: Mark sheet for last appeared examination

deadline.text: Apply on MahaDBT; no date on scheme page
